name: nexa
description: Databricks Semantic Ontology & Explainable AI Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w services/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w services/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w services/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w services/api && npm run test -w apps/web
